questions.prompt: Jayson Tatum scored 46 in an elimination game at Milwaukee in 2022. How many did he score in Boston's 2023 Game 7 against Philadelphia?
questions.note: 51 points, a new playoff Game 7 scoring mark.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he scored a playoff career-high 51 points in a 112–88 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers

funFacts.text: He overtook Stephen Curry's previous elimination-game scoring mark.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: surpassed Stephen Curry (50 points)

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in a 112–88 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers

funFacts.text: Tatum became the first Celtic to score 50 in multiple playoff games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first player in Celtics history to put up multiple 50-point playoff games

questions.prompt: How many consecutive games did Milwaukee win to open 2018–19?
questions.context: Milwaukee Bucks · start of Giannis's first MVP season
questions.note: Seven in a row before their first defeat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks opened the season with seven straight wins

funFacts.text: The Bucks' season-opening victory was a one-point road win over Charlotte.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: October 17 @ Charlotte W 113–112

funFacts.text: Milwaukee's first loss came on the road against Boston in early November.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: November 1 @ Boston L 113–117

funFacts.text: That opening run marked the club's fastest start since its early-1970s title-contending era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first time they started a season 7–0 since 1971–72

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry’s streak of regular-season games with a made three ended in November 2016. How many games did it last?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive regular-season games with a made three-pointer: 157

funFacts.text: The streak stopped in Los Angeles when Curry couldn't make an outside shot against the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Los Angeles Lakers, with Curry going 0 for 10 from three-point range

funFacts.text: Kyle Korver had held the previous regular-season made-three streak record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: previous record of 127 held by Kyle Korver

funFacts.text: Across regular-season and playoff games combined, Curry had also set a separate longer made-three streak.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive games (regular-season and postseason combined) with a made three-pointer
